summary: Creatureless Rakdos control: tax creature boards, copy artifact mana, and finish with oversized X-burn.

tags.name: burn
tags.reason: Large X-damage and life-loss spells are the primary finish.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Permanent taxes and sweepers constrain creature development.

tags.name: big mana
tags.reason: Coffers, Black Market, Mana Geyser, rocks, and Doubling Cube fund the finish.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: The mana engine relies on artifacts and repeated untaps.

tags.name: stax
tags.reason: Mudslide, Engineered Plague, Lethal Vapors, and entrance punishers restrict creature play.

tags.name: group slug
tags.reason: Mogis and Shivan Gorge drain the table, but X-burn remains the main kill.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: Instants and sorceries finish the game without forming a cast-count engine.
